idea-plugin.name: AI Model Retirement Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the LLM model IDs pinned in your code that vendors have already switched off, or have dated to switch off, with the replacement and the date.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → AI Model Retirement Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 33 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/ai-model-retirement-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/ai-model-retirement-lint

action.text: AI Model Retirement Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run AI Model Retirement Lint on the file in the editor
